name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: The AI Executive Assistant (eA9Zf) should auto-generate the top 3 contradictions from the full transcript of every pending video. This cuts review time by surfacing key conflicts upfront, letting editors focus on fixing them instead of hunting for issues. The trade-off is accepting occasional false positives—some flagged contradictions may not be meaningful—but the time saved outweighs the minor cleanup.

name: Scriv
text: The real risk isn’t the 30-second delay—it’s that auto-generating contradictions forces editors to chase false positives instead of real editorial conflicts. Better: have Reel’s team flag the top 3 *actual* contradictions from the transcript, verified by a human in the loop. Settle it by running a blind test—compare auto-generated vs. human-verified contradictions on 10 videos, measure editor time saved vs. accuracy lost.
